status: ESTIMATES FOR THE DM TO CORRECT. Your notes do not state what any town makes or uses. Every figure here is a best guess from town size, what the notes say a town is known for, and where it sits on the map. Nothing here is canon. Change any figure on the Living World page (Places) or in this file and rebuild.

method.use: What a town uses is the same amount per head everywhere (useperThousandPeoplePerDay below), times its population.
method.make: What a town makes is spread so that the five Crestfall towns together make about as much as they use. Trade with places outside Crestfall is not simulated yet, so nothing arrives from outside.
method.madeFrom: Two goods are made from another: healing potions from herbs, and weapons from ore. Their makers' needs are added to what a town uses of the input.
